title: Newscast - Can AI Actually Be Slowed Down? - BBC Sounds
text:

News,·14 Sep 2026,·33 mins

Available for over a year

Today, can governments work together to regulate AI, after growing safety fears in the industry?

Donald Trump, has seemingly dismissed calls for government intervention made over the weekend. The President cited the AI race with China, saying “whoever wins AI, wins.” So is there anything the UK government can do?

Meanwhile the calls for a slow down in AI development has led to tech stocks falling in Europe, US and Asia. 

Alex and James are joined by Darren Jones Labour MP and former chief secretary to the Prime Minister, who has been calling on the government for the regulation and safe development of superintelligence.
